title: Care Academy Notes — Promotion Codes Applied After Checkout on Online Orders
content:
A promotion code that was valid on the placed date but was not entered at checkout can still be applied to an Online Orders order afterwards, as a credit on the order's lines.

## The rule

A code missing at checkout is applied afterwards only if it is requested no later than the late-code window of 7 calendar days after the order is placed. Days are counted as calendar days after the placed date, the placed date being day zero, and the last day counts. The late code must have been valid on the placed date, the order must carry no other code, and the lines credited must not be cancelled or already returned; the credit is refunded to the original tenders.

The placed date, any code already on the order and any earlier late-code credit are all read from the order's records.

## Questions and answers

**From which day is the window counted?**
From the placed date, which is day zero. Day 1 is the next calendar day, and day 7 is the last day on which the request is in time.

**The code was launched two days after the order was placed. Can it be applied late?**
No. A late code must have been valid on the placed date.

**The order was placed with a code, and the customer now has a better one.**
The order already carries a code, so no late code is applied.

**A late code has already been credited to the order once.**
The order then carries a code, so no further late code is applied to it.

**One of the lines has since been returned.**
That line is not credited; only lines neither cancelled nor already returned are credited.

**Where does the money go?**
To the original tenders of the order.

## Window boundary (hypothetical order placed on 10 April 2026)

| Request date | Day after placement | Within the 7-day window |
|---|---|---|
| 10 April 2026 | Day 0 | Yes |
| 17 April 2026 | Day 7 | Yes, the last day counts |
| 18 April 2026 | Day 8 | No |

## How the credit shows on the order

Each line credited by the late code receives its share of the code's discount as a credit on that line, recorded with the code applied and the date it was applied.
